backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for key frontend source files and constants.
frontend/index.css: Defines global OKLCH-based color variables and Tailwind utility layers for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up title, fonts, manifest, icons, and root mount point.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app metadata, theme colors, start URL, and icons for Maleeha Focus.
frontend/public/sw.js: Basic service worker handling install, activate, caching, and fetch events using a static asset list.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring TanStack Router routes, theme provider, service worker registration, and layout.
frontend/src/components/attendance/Atten: UI component showing attendance stats with progress bar and totals for a selected subject.
frontend/src/components/attendance/Month: Interactive monthly calendar allowing marking attendance per day with visual status indicators.
frontend/src/components/attendance/Subje: UI list for subjects with add, edit, delete, and selection handling via dialog and dropdown.
frontend/src/components/focus/Distractio: Button toggle for enabling or disabling distraction reduction mode.
frontend/src/components/focus/ProgressCi: Canvas-based circular progress indicator drawing background and progress arcs.
frontend/src/components/home/AddTaskButt: Floating bottom button that triggers task creation.
frontend/src/components/home/CategoryCar: Grid of category cards displaying icons and task counts with selection highlight.
frontend/src/components/home/QuoteCard.t: Daily quote display with refresh button powered by useDailyQuote hook.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main app layout with routed content and bottom navigation bar that hides in focus mute mode.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Top bar showing current date and an optional theme toggle.
frontend/src/components/tasks/CategoryFi: Horizontal filter bar for selecting or clearing task categories.
frontend/src/components/tasks/CategoryPi: Form controls for selecting a task category and optional Pharm-D subject.
frontend/src/components/tasks/ForMaleeha: Quick-add card listing preset 'For Maleeha' tasks.
frontend/src/components/tasks/ForTarubaQ: Empty placeholder file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskFormDi: Dialog form for creating or editing tasks with category and subject handling.
frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskList.t: Renders a list of task cards with completion, edit, delete, and category display options.
frontend/src/constants/categories.ts: Defines task categories, Pharm-D subjects, and associated UI color classes.
frontend/src/constants/chotuQuotes.ts: Provides an array of motivational quote strings.
frontend/src/constants/forMaleehaPresets: Defines preset task suggestions for the 'For Maleeha' category.
Empty preset list placeholder for Taruba.
frontend/src/constants/muzzamilQuotes.ts: Empty placeholder for Muzzamil quote data.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAttendance.ts: Manages attendance subjects, marks, and statistics with local storage persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyQuote.ts: Generates and stores a daily motivational quote with refresh capability.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusTimer.ts: Implements a 45-minute focus and 5-minute break timer with controls and progress tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, login logic, identity loading, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useNotifications.ts: Handles browser notification permissions, settings, and sending notifications with local persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useTasks.ts: Manages CRUD operations for tasks with legacy data normalization and local storage syncing.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Wraps next-themes to expose theme state, dark-mode detection, and toggling.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes, plus custom utilities for Maleeha accent styling.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a helper function that merges conditional class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.tsx: Renders attendance tracking UI with subject management, stats, and a calendar using the useAttendance hook.
frontend/src/pages/FocusPage.tsx: Implements a focus timer page with phases, notifications, progress circle, and distraction‑mute mode.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the home dashboard with quotes, categories, task filtering, and task creation/editing.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Provides settings for theme, notifications, and app info using UI cards and switches.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Registers a service worker on page load and logs update availability.
frontend/src/storage/localStore.ts: Provides versioned localStorage helpers for saving, loading, and removing app data.
frontend/src/types/attendance.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for attendance subjects, marks, stored data, and computed stats.
frontend/src/types/tasks.ts: Defines task categories, subjects, task structure, and task form data types.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config enabling dark mode, custom OKLCH color palette, fonts, shadows, and keyframes, plus plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state describing requirements for an English-only iOS app “Maleeha Focus,” including features, architecture notes, theming, and update tasks.
